messages.content: From ChIP-seq peaks in human hepatocytes we made a network where each link goes from a transcription factor to one of its target genes, saved as a CSV with source (TF), target (gene) and a numeric weight column; TF and gene IDs never overlap. I'd like to break this network into modules of TFs together with the genes they control.
